text_zh: ……我觉得有人在按我，但也许只是风
text_en: ...I think someone presses me, but maybe just wind

text_zh: ……这些铅字好冰，还是那个人的手暖一些
text_en: ...these slugs so cold, that person's hands warmer
...am I a desk? or something else

text_zh: ……听到远处齿轮声，好像在叫我名字
text_en: ...hear distant gears, like calling my name

text_zh: ……那个人总是先洗手，很恭敬的
text_en: ...that person always washed hands first, so reverent

text_zh: ……那个人总在R键前停顿，手在抖
text_en: ...that person always paused at R, hands shaking

text_zh: ……翻来翻去找什么条例，很紧张
text_en: ...flipping pages for some regulation, so nervous
...the one who drew, hands so light and quick

text_zh: ……最后按得很开心，像是要去哪里
text_en: ...pressed so happily at the end, like going somewhere
